summary.text: Jenny Wilson is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces William Fessenden.
She has run for the House in several earlier elections without winning, most recently in Strafford 19 in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Wilson was a Republican candidate for the House in Strafford 4 in 2018 and 2020, losing both general elections.
Ballotpedia also lists a 2014 race, in which she advanced from the Republican primary before losing the general election.
In 2024 she ran in Strafford 19 and again was not elected.
